name: University of the West of Scotland

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of the West of Scotland (UWS) is a significant force in global knowledge and a leading provider of career-focused education in Scotland. While it was formally established as UWS in 2007 through a merger, its roots date back to 1897.

UWS operates across four academic schools:

  • School of Business and Creative Industries
  • School of Computing, Engineering and Physical Sciences
  • School of Education and Social Sciences
  • School of Health and Life Sciences

The university is highly regarded for its research, with 90% of its work classed as world-leading or internationally excellent in the Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2021.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At UWS, you will find a strong community feel where you are treated as an individual rather than just another number. With a diverse student body representing over 140 countries, the campus culture is inclusive and global.

You can join various student clubs and societies that cater to a wide range of interests, helping you build a network of friends from day one. The university also provides extensive support services, including the "Student Hub" for academic and personal guidance, and dedicated support for mature and international students.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UWS provides a variety of on-campus accommodation options to help you settle in quickly.

  • Options: You can choose from modern student residences at the Paisley and Ayr campuses, which offer single en-suite rooms and shared kitchen facilities.
  • Support: The university offers guidance on both university-owned housing and finding private rentals in the local area.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Each campus has up-to-date library facilities with physical and digital resources, study zones, and more.

Sports
Across the campuses, you’ll find gyms and fitness facilities, plus organised sports clubs to keep you active.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll also find modern lab spaces for subjects like science, health and technology, plus creative studios.

Cafeteria
UWS campuses have various dining facilities with options for quick bites and meals, along with canteen setups.

highlights.title: Campuses
highlights.value:
Paisley Campus

Located in the heart of Scotland’s largest town, this is the main administrative hub. It is just a 10-minute train ride from Glasgow city centre. It features the main library and extensive engineering and computing facilities.

Lanarkshire Campus

An award-winning, £110m sustainable campus located in the Hamilton International Technology Park. It focuses on modern, collaborative learning and is carbon-neutral in its operations.

Ayr Campus

Set on the Craigie Estate by the River Ayr, this £81 million campus provides a beautiful environment for students in nursing, education, and creative industries.

Dumfries Campus

Situated on the historic Crichton estate, this campus offers a stunning rural backdrop for study, sharing facilities with other regional institutions.

London Campus

Located in the historic London Docklands, this campus offers a dynamic, flexible learning environment with panoramic views of the city. It primarily caters to business and management students.
